title: Pune Building Collapse Sparks Rescue Efforts
summary: A building in Pune's Pimpri-Chinchwad area partially collapsed, leaving several people trapped under the rubble. The incident has raised concerns about construction safety and rescue operations. Authorities have been called to the scene to assist with the rescue efforts.
summary_points: A building collapse occurred in Pune's Pimpri-Chinchwad area
Several people are trapped under the rubble
Rescue efforts are underway, involving military personnel
